processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Sample is identified as 'hot-rolled' in the Fig. 1b caption; no specific rolling temperature, reduction, or post-deformation cooling is reported in the text for this Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C-0.29Si-0.44Nb-0.44Mo steel.

structures.overall_structure: Fine equiaxed austenite grains with annealing twins, pinned by NbC particles on grain boundaries

phases_present.morphology: second-phase particles at grain boundaries and in grain interiors

precipitates.distribution: on austenite grain boundaries and in grain interiors

interfaces.interface_notes: NbC particles pin austenite grain boundaries; parallel annealing twins are present within the austenite grains.

characterization_methods.technique: Optical microscopy - differential interference contrast (DIC) imaging
characterization_methods.purpose: Reveal and compare the hot-rolled microstructure with the as-cast condition
characterization_methods.key_findings: Fine equiaxed austenite grains with annealing twins; average grain size 50 µm; NbC particles pin grain boundaries and are present inside grains.

unmapped_findings: The sample's nominal composition is Fe-29Mn-6Al-0.9C-0.29Si-0.44Nb-0.44Mo (values in wt.% per the paper's chemistry convention) as given in the Fig. 1b caption ([b0009], figure_001).
Hot rolling converted the as-cast millimetre-scale primary austenite dendrites into fine equiaxed austenite grains with annealing twins; the steel is fully austenitic ([b0007], figure_001).
